integrity_notes: Published generic threshold and regular-biclique equilibrium are acknowledged as prior results.
The reverse ordering is an explicit consequence of a general stationary-load relation inherent in Punzo’s model, not a separate novelty claim.
No independent validation, expert review or external certification has been performed.
First public source date is verified online publication on 2022-01-10; an earlier repository deposit timestamp has unverified public visibility.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic mean-field ODE equilibria only; positive-endemic global stability is not proved here.
Undirected unweighted complete bipartite networks, homogeneous positive recovery, and conserved positive endogenous load only.
No finite-population stochastic extinction conclusion or extension to directed, weighted or adaptive networks.
Equivalent algebraic representations in unindexed sources remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact endemic equilibria and opposite risk–load rankings in flow-regulated bipartite SIS networks
